name: midh_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for MIDH authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: midh_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check eligibility. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: midh_check_eligibility
description: Checks eligibility for MIDH horticulture subsidy based on land ownership, crop suitability, category (general/SC-ST/women/hilly region), and prior subsidy history. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if farmer has existing MIDH subsidy for same land (duplicate), land records unavailable, or crop-region mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_select_component
description: Selects a MIDH scheme component for the application. Returns component details, subsidy rates, and requirements. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if component_type unsupported or not available in the farmer's region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_submit_application
description: Submits a MIDH scheme application. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Farmer must be eligible. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve application. Fails if ineligible, duplicate, or incomplete project details.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_track_application_status
description: Returns application_status ('not_applied', 'submitted', 'under_review', 'approved', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_calculate_subsidy
description: Calculates subsidy amount based on component, project cost, beneficiary category, and region. Subsidy varies (40-55%). Returns farmer's share and subsidy cap. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse. Fails if application rejected or cost invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_track_project_status
description: Tracks project_status ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'partially_completed', 'completed', 'verified'). Subsidy may be released in stages based on progress. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify project. Fails if application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_verify_project
description: Records inspection/verification result. Transitions project to 'verified' on pass. Verification MANDATORY before subsidy. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse. Fails if project not completed, inspection finds issues.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_track_subsidy
description: Tracks subsidy_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'approved', 'partially_disbursed', 'disbursed', 'failed'). Subsidy may be staged based on project completion milestones. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate disbursement. Fails if project not verified.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_get_scheme_details
description: Returns detailed MIDH scheme information including components, subsidy rates, eligibility criteria, and caps. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT check individual eligibility. Fails if scheme details temporarily unavailable.

name: midh_schedule_inspection
description: Schedules inspection for completed project. Project must be 'completed'. Transitions inspection_status to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Fails if project not completed or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_cancel_application
description: Cancels a MIDH application. Only when 'submitted' or 'under_review'. Requires session_token. Fails if already approved or project started.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_raise_grievance
description: Raises MIDH grievance. Categories: 'application_rejected', 'inspection_failure', 'subsidy_not_received', 'delay_in_processing', 'eligibility_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: midh_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks MIDH grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
